stem: A train makes a 1,210-kilometer trip from Lahore to Karachi at a constant speed. After the train has traveled for 5 hours, 815 kilometers of the trip remain. What is the train's speed, in kilometers per hour?
solution: Let \(s\) be the speed. After 5 hours the train has covered \(5s\) kilometers.
verify:
s = symbols('s')
sol = solve(Eq(1210 - 5*s, 815), s)
assert sol == [79]
assert [Rational(a) for a in spr_answers] == sol
